sources.snippet: The Rev3auth/iris-1.3-lite-lora is a 1 billion parameter instruction-tuned causal language model, finetuned by Rev3auth from unsloth/gemma-3-1b-it-unsloth-bnb-4bit. This model was trained using Unsloth, enabling 2x faster finetuning. With a context length of 32768 tokens, it is optimized for efficient performance in various language generation tasks.
